1,671 incidents · one model

A field of light, held together — which is roughly how AI looks from outside. Every one of the 1,671 recorded incidents is a body in here. Across, they are placed by how much they resemble each other; in depth, by when they happened — this year at the front, 1983 receding behind. The threads cross the years. The green phages are the environmental cost of producing each incident — the energy burned, riding the harm rather than standing beside it as a harm of its own. Scroll in to bring it into focus, ask it something, or click any body to read what happened.
